bundle.shortDescription: Metadata indexer and viewer for AI-generated images
bundle.longDescription: Berry AIGC Toolbox is an open-source metadata indexer and viewer for AI-generated images supporting AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI, NovelAI, InvokeAI, Fooocus, EasyDiffusion, and Stable Swarm.
